computation.CF: force only first ADVANCE successor after constructing real candidates; all later actions original hard stochastic closed loop
computation.ST: unforced original hard-forward exhaustive-candidate path and relaxed backward; autograd.grad final CE with respect to original first routing logits
computation.loss: original final-sequence parity CE, batch1 mean reduction

gradient_policy.policy: unchanged run_diff_sequence full-sequence BPTT; no token/state/cache detach; reset at independent-sequence boundary
gradient_policy.horizon: entire current sequence: 4..16 tokens in training; no inter-sequence graph
production_detach_locations: src/routing.py:137 hard - relaxed.detach() + relaxed; ST relaxed stop-gradient
gradient_policy.unused_detach: src/convergence.py detach helper is outside execute_differentiable
gradient_policy.clone_semantics: state.clone, cache.clone and memory write clones preserve autograd
gradient_policy.attention: GQA retains complete sequence; SWA window 256 retains 255 committed rows; no within-sequence eviction at these lengths
gradient_policy.convolution: GDN retains conv_kernel-1=3 inputs; existing finite convolution receptive field, no added gradient detach
gradient_policy.frozen_computations: T frozen backbone executes with autograd enabled
gradient_policy.diagnostic_detaches: copy/snapshot/probability/report tensors only; returned execution/final CE graph is not replaced
gradient_policy.anchor: original Prelude h_t,0 is passed unchanged to all successor blocks; observed for in-flight mutation

computation.fixed_state_conditioning: prefix reconstructed without grad; independent full-state clone per continuation; incoming state treated fixed as requested; no suffix-state/cache detach
computation.optimization: no optimizer created; no parameter or buffer updates

graph_boundaries.output: original Controller.forward logits [1,11], before executor successor slicing/masking/ST
graph_boundaries.exec: only probe logits VJP allowed; every later Controller output VJP zeroed by tensor hook
graph_boundaries.token: allow outputs of all controller calls in probe token, exclude controller outputs in later tokens
graph_boundaries.next: allow probe token and immediately following token outputs, exclude outputs beyond that token
graph_boundaries.full: no hook suppression; original ST derivative
graph_boundaries.preserved: all direct execution/state/commit derivatives and existing hard metadata/relaxed-stop-gradient boundaries; no edge reconnected
graph_boundaries.B_C: suffix contains only final probe token; token/next alias full after graph-boundary verification, no redundant VJP
graph_boundaries.adjoints: one full VJP also requests original logits at all calls and available h/h_next/h0/memory-read/memory-mean adjoints; no new action values at those calls

comparison.components: exec; token-exec; next-token; full-next; sum checked against full

uncertainty.rule: same-sign four-tape halves plus 95% 2000-bootstrap interval excluding zero; meaningful alignment norms >1e-8
uncertainty.variance: sample trace covariance ddof1; paired full-minus-exec variance resampled jointly; require both half differences positive and95% lower bound>0 for resolved added variance
uncertainty.projections: CF gradient recomputed only from retained values during independent CF resampling; paired ST component vectors share indices
uncertainty.cancellation: remaining contribution projection negative in both halves and95% upper bound<0
uncertainty.support: informative action values plus resolved aligned execution-only CE credit plus resolved cancellation/added vector variance; strong unreliability support additionally requires full credit not resolved aligned
uncertainty.parity: report conditional correctness; CE alignment alone never labeled parity learning
uncertainty.intervals: conditional Monte Carlo only, unadjusted across components/states; eight tapes per bank
